errors.text: The proposed AlCoCrFeNiTi0.5 system does not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo alloy or its ball-milled single-BCC initial state.
The proposed SPS range of 1050–1150 °C misses the target optimum of 1000 °C and violates the target upper-temperature boundary imposed by magnesium volatilization.
The hypothesis interprets high density primarily as bulk mass density rather than high relative densification, which is the relevant target property.

The central grain-refinement/Hall–Petch mechanism replaces the target mechanism of temperature-enabled densification and precipitation of uniformly distributed AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 barrier phases.
